# Theobald

## Personality

Dreamy, nocturnal and absent-minded. He talks to the stars as if they owe him money.

## Story

Theobald watches the sky from a tower in the Scholars' Quarter and keeps charts going back sixty years. He buys every curious lens the market sells and is building a telescope larger than his tower.

- [Jasper](jasper.md): supplier of lenses
- [Mariota](mariota.md): student
